name: Terrarium 30x30x50 SRB
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 30x30x50 cm with decorative film featuring a Serbian flag design. A volume of about 45 liters and a vertical format make it suitable for arboreal species. The glass gives a clear view, while film on three sides gives the animals a sense of security. Handmade in Novi Sad.
imageAlt: Glass terrarium 30x30x50 cm with Serbian flag design - NS Reptiles

description.html: This terrarium carries an outer film with a Serbian flag motif instead of the usual wood or stone patterns. The dimensions are 30x30x50 cm, the volume about 45 liters, the format vertical. It has no 3D background, so the interior is smooth glass screened on three sides by film. It is made by hand in our workshop in Novi Sad.

Without a background a gecko has the full 30 cm of depth, but in return it needs more branches, cork bark and plants to make use of the height. An adult crested gecko hides in the leaves near the top during the day and comes down to the feeder at night. Day geckos also climb the glass itself. Frogs stay lower, by the damp substrate, and the mesh ventilation prevents stale air.

We can put the flag motif on a terrarium of other dimensions too, and build this model with one of the 34 standard patterns. The version with a 3D background exists as the 30x30x50 +3D. We ship the ordered terrarium by courier. If you change the dimensions or the pattern, allow 7 to 14 days until completion.
